blocks.text: Computer Management groups System & Recovery, Network & Remote, Security & Accounts, Devices & Desktop, Containers & AI, and Files & Documents. Menu choices delegate to the repository's existing fixed helpers.

Read the prompt, identify what will change and save affected work. A read-only status view differs from restarting a service, updating packages or restoring storage. The authentication agent appears only where the selected administrative action requires it.

Record the action name and sanitized error. Inspect its owning service/log through Maintenance & Health. Do not repeatedly retry an operation with an uncertain outcome. Retain any recovery material path the helper reports.
Launching the entire management UI with sudo bypasses the intended user/session boundary. Use the ordinary desktop entry and existing authorization prompts.
